facts.site: Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility
facts.title: pressure release during a statutory inspection on P-3223

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was no injury or loss. The potential outcome was rated 2 against the site's consequence scale, above the 0 actually realised.

defences.finding: Control ENERGY_SOURCE_IDENTIFICATION: the identification of every energy source for the task was never verified as effective, and the learning team review classified this as an absent or failed defence.
Control ISOLATION_HANDBACK_CONTROL: the controlled removal of isolation and return to service was not in place, and the learning team review classified this as an absent or failed defence.
Control LOAD_SUPPORT_FOR_MAINTENANCE: the mechanical support of a load during maintenance access was not in place, and the learning team review classified this as an organisational factor.
Control PARK_UP_AND_RESTRAINT: the parking, chocking and restraint of equipment was in place but did not perform, and the learning team review classified this as a task or environmental condition.
Control ZERO_ENERGY_VERIFICATION: the proving zero energy before intrusive work was never verified as effective, and the learning team review classified this as a task or environmental condition.

recommendations: Restore the identification of every energy source for the task on P-3223 and record the assurance activity before this task is next authorised.
Restore the controlled removal of isolation and return to service on P-3223 and record the assurance activity before this task is next authorised.
response.sequence: Work was under way in applying and verifying an isolation, specifically proving dead and testing for zero energy. P-3223 (slurry transfer pumps) is in service for cyclone feed and tailings transfer. The task proceeded during a statutory inspection while the identification of every energy source for the task was never verified as effective. The pressure energy involved is held as hydraulic accumulator, and the recorded presentation was jet release, stored-energy discharge, rupture.
response.summary: On 2 February 2023 an incident occurred on P-3223 at Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility during a statutory inspection, releasing pressure energy held as hydraulic accumulator.
